description_en: This crude storage shed houses 15 old wheels and two axels of the Buṅgadyaḥ Chariot. Regrettably, the age of the various wheels and axles are not documented. The structure consists of two longitudinal walls supporting a badly corroded metal roof upheld by timber trusses. Lacking windows or doors, the structure remains open on the gable ends.Scheduled for demolition, as per information from the Ward Office (March 2024), this shed holds historical significance. Plans include exhibiting one or more of the large wooden wheels at the museum currently under construction just west of the shed. However, the fate of the remaining wheels remains uncertain.
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
